judge.rationale: The candidate is an incomplete work-in-progress that stops after implementing only the first two facets of its plan. While it adds `ajv` to `package.json` and compiles the schema inside `ToolRegistry.register`, it never actually modifies `ToolRegistry.execute` to run the validator or return a rejection `ToolResponse`. As a result, three of the four tests in the newly added `src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts` will fail immediately when run. Additionally, it is missing the dynamic schema `WeakMap` caching, several required unit tests in `registry.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, the doc comment on `execute`, and all documentation updates to `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, and `example/weather-tool.ts`. It also leaves `.lore/dod.md` and `registry.acceptance.test.ts` tracked in the tree.
